business_summary: China Investment Financial Technology Group Limited, an investment holding company, engages in cryptocurrency business in Hong Kong. The company operates in four segments: Cryptocurrency Business, Financial Services, Equine Services, and Sales of Electronic Appliance. It is involved in mining and sales of cryptocurrency; trading of electronic appliance; and provision of stallion services and investment in stallions. The company also provides securities, and futures and options brokerage, as well as margin financing; securities trading; investment management, including managed account, hedge funds, private funds, dedicated funds and investment advisory services for individual and corporate clients; financial products comprising personal loans, home mortgages, equity financing, equity mortgage, and corporate finance, SME loan, and corporate loan. The company was formerly known as Imperium Financial Group Limited and changed its name to China Investment Financial Technology Group Limited in February 2026. China Investment Financial Technology Group Limited was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 China Investment Financial Technology Group Limited는 홍콩에서 암호화폐 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 암호화폐 사업, 금융 서비스, 말 서비스, 전자 기기 판매 등 4개 부문으로 운영됩니다. 암호화폐 채굴 및 판매에 관여합니다. 전자제품 거래; 종마 서비스 제공 및 종마에 대한 투자. 이 회사는 또한 증권, 선물 및 옵션 중개는 물론 마진 금융도 제공합니다. 증권 거래; 개인 및 기업 고객을 위한 관리 계좌, 헤지 펀드, 사모 펀드, 전용 펀드 및 투자 자문 서비스를 포함한 투자 관리; 개인대출, 주택담보대출, 주식금융, 주식담보대출, 기업금융, 중소기업대출, 기업대출 등으로 구성된 금융상품입니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Imperium Financial Group Limited로 알려졌으며 2026년 2월에 China Investment Financial Technology Group Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. China Investment Financial Technology Group Limited는 1993년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 Kwun Tong에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
